welcome:
👋 Welcome to Meetory!

Meetory helps you save interesting events to shared calendars.

Connect Google Calendar to get started.

help.title: Meetory helps you save events to your calendars.
help.description:
Simply:

• forward an event announcement;
or
• describe the event in your own words.

Meetory will recognize it and offer to save it to your calendar.
